newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's UBK soars in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's UBK soars in early trade.

text.p: Shares in Slovenian bank UBK soared 9.01 percent to 7,500 tolars by 0900 GMT on Monday, with buying encouraged by Thursday's news the country's second largest bank SKB would buy 51 percent of UBK.
"I expect UBK could jump to 10,000 tolars in the next 10 days on the news although the share will remain fairly illiquid due to a general mistrust in smaller banks," one trader said.
SKB and UBK said they would form a banking group from July 1 in order to cut costs.
UBK is a minnow in the Alpine republic's overcrowded banking sector with a market share of less than one percent.
UBK has so far jumped 19 percent since the news broke as its link-up with SKB is expected to ease UBK's liquidity problems, analysts said. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
